training_API.validation: provider derives permitted model IDs/orgs from frozen splits and source-qualified context; requested model set and org set must equal intended current train or inner validation request; reject duplicate/missing/extra IDs, outer H org, unknown target/context
training_API.contexts: outer{k}/inner{j}/train -> U qualified rows; /validation -> V qualified rows; outer{k}/final_train -> qualified A rows
training_API.inner_validation: V outcomes only used for validation loss, never supervised fit or preprocessing; V subset A
training_API.process_scope: each outer fold fresh worker; provider audit log exact requested/returned ID+org hashes, context, time; no all-target load-and-slice in model worker
training_API.target_count: n_valid_HS is metadata qualification only, never feature or tuning input

production_gates.fit_or_scoring: V-D ACCEPT + DESIGN_RELEASE.json pins plan/contract/source/code/environment hashes; target ready marker before requests
production_gates.aggregate_reveal: all5 outer folds and all24 cells complete on identical row IDs; candidates and four-group recommendations sealed; independent reviewer/main controller verifies then SCORING_RELEASE.json pins all artifacts

scoring_API: scoring_targets(seal_path,seal_sha); fixed provider-owned targets; no arbitrary target path accepted; verify release and current content SHA for all4 artifacts + seal
